_about: Curated lists of papers that use the data affected by a register entry. A paper is listed only when its abstract (or the paper itself) shows it uses the affected data over the affected region and a period that spans the problem. Papers we are screening or have contacted stay off until their contact window has closed. Inclusion says nothing about whether the paper's conclusions change: the effect is not assessed. Candidates for review are refreshed weekly in data/affected_candidates.json (not shown on the site).

nasa-merra-2-corrected-precipitation-ove.criterion: Uses MERRA-2 land hydrology (soil moisture, runoff, corrected precipitation) or CPC Unified precipitation over Australia, for a period that spans 2015–16.
nasa-merra-2-corrected-precipitation-ove.query: ("MERRA-2" OR MERRA2 OR "CPC Unified" OR CPCU OR "CPC gauge") AND (Australia OR Australian) AND (precipitation OR rainfall OR drought OR "soil moisture")

papers.title: Potential of long-term satellite observations and reanalysis products for characterising soil drying: trends and drought events
papers.uses: MERRA-2 surface and root-zone soil moisture trends (global, includes Australia)

papers.title: Evaluation of reanalysis soil moisture products using cosmic ray neutron sensor observations across the globe
papers.uses: MERRA-2 soil moisture evaluated against sensors that include the CosmOz Australia network
papers.period: Sensor records, mostly 2010s (exact years not checked)

asos-wind-sensors.criterion: Uses US station wind speeds (ASOS through ISD, GSOD or HadISD) for a period that spans ASOS commissioning (1992–99) or the 2005–09 sonic anemometer swap.
asos-wind-sensors.query: ("wind stilling" OR "terrestrial stilling" OR "atmospheric stilling" OR "near-surface wind speed") AND ("United States" OR "North America" OR "Northern Hemisphere" OR global OR HadISD OR ASOS)

papers.title: Wind speed trends over the contiguous United States
papers.uses: Observed US station wind speed trends (two observational datasets)

papers.title: Northern Hemisphere atmospheric stilling partly attributed to an increase in surface roughness
papers.uses: Northern Hemisphere station wind speeds, including North America

papers.title: Evaluation of Global Reanalysis Land Surface Wind Speed Trends to Support Wind Energy Development Using In Situ Observations
papers.venue: Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology
papers.uses: 1439 in situ stations worldwide as the reference for reanalysis wind trends (US share not checked)
